Bow Attack Skills are one of the Skill Types. Currently the only NPC bow attack skills in the game are the ones used by the Skeleton Archer.

## Lists of Bow Attack Skills[]

| Icon | Skill Name | Skill Description | Skill Type | Cooldown |
| | Detonating Arrow | Fires an arrow that embeds itself in a target then explodes after 0.6 seconds. All added Bow Damage applies to the explosion at 150% effectiveness. | Bow Attack | |
| | Hail of Arrows | Launch a hail of arrows into the sky that rain down on the target location over 3.5 seconds. Added Bow Damage is applied at 300% effectiveness per second. | Bow Attack | 2 |
| | Multishot | A bow attack that fires a cone of 5 arrows in the target direction. Aiming the cursor further from your character reduces the spread. | Bow Attack | |

### NPC[]

| Icon | Skill Name | Skill Description | Skill Type | Cooldown |
| | Bow Attack | Fires an arrow at the target, dealing physical damage. | Bow Attack | |
| | Poison Arrow | Deals physical damage and poisons on hit. | Bow Attack | 4 |
| | Multishot | Bow attack that fires 5 arrows in a cone. | Bow Attack | 6 |
